body:
## Context

Release-audit BLOCKER (install/first-run; release-blockers.md, pkg:runner). PR #515 switched assertPhase to `readOwnManifestChain(dir, { cwd })` (packages/runner/lib/assertions.mjs:568) but destructures only `{ entries, skipped }` — `identityError` is dropped. The same PR taught recordAcceptancePacket to surface it (packages/runner/lib/acceptance.mjs:185-191), so the asymmetry is an oversight. In a detached-HEAD checkout of a forest-mode repo (the state actions/checkout leaves every PR build in), own-chain refuses with entries: [] and the refusal lands in `skipped`; bin/adlc.mjs:89 renders that channel as `malformed manifest lines: N`. The operator is told the ledger is corrupt and evidence is missing when the actual, actionable sentence ("cannot establish this checkout's own causal chain: detached HEAD has no branch identity…") is sitting unread in skipped[0].error. The gate fails CLOSED (correct); this is a diagnostics defect only.

DELIBERATELY OUT OF SCOPE: any `--branch`/env chain-name hint. A self-reported branch identity is exactly the claim refuse() exists to deny; that design question is a separate follow-up ticket.

## What to change

1. `packages/runner/lib/assertions.mjs` (assertPhase, :568) — destructure `identityError` and surface it distinctly in the result (mirroring acceptance.mjs:185-191), so callers can tell an identity refusal from a malformed line.
2. `packages/runner/bin/adlc.mjs` (:89) — print each skipped entry's own error text; reserve the "malformed manifest lines" wording for entries that are actually malformed. When identityError is present, print it verbatim.
3. Test: detached-HEAD case using the real-git `repo()` scaffold in packages/runner/test/own-chain-chronology.test.mjs (`git checkout --detach` after committing segments).

## Acceptance criteria

1. Detached-HEAD fixture: the runner's failure output contains "detached HEAD has no branch identity" and does NOT contain "malformed manifest lines" when the identity refusal is the only skip. verify: `node --test packages/runner/test/own-chain-chronology.test.mjs` exits 0 with the new test present.
2. A genuinely malformed manifest line still reports as malformed. verify: `node --test packages/runner/test/runner.test.mjs` exits 0 (existing malformed-line coverage stays green).
3. Whole package suite green. verify: `node --test packages/runner/test/*.test.mjs` exits 0.
title: runner: surface the own-chain identityError — detached-HEAD refusal must not print as 'malformed manifest lines'
